'''Snelle''' is a gambler who frequents [[The Dusty Wheel]].
== Activities ==
Snelle plays dice against [[Mat Cauthon]] at The Dusty Wheel, although Mat does not know the specific game they are playing. Mat rolls five ones, and he, [[Rittle]], and [[Saddler]] tell Mat that he lost the game, although Mat knows that he has actually won it. Mat asks the room about the game, and no-one answers, with Snelle telling Mat that he shouldn't have bet on a game he didn't know. Rittler recognizes who Mat really is, and the gamblers leave the inn, as well as giving Mat his due share of their money.{{ref/book|13|31}}
== Trivia ==
* Snelle is named for Michael Schnelle, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
